children: American Healthcare REIT, Inc. (NYSE: AHR) (“Company”) announced today that Jeff Hanson, the Company’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Gabe Willhite, the Company’s President and Chief Operating Officer, and Alan Peterson, the Company’s Vice President of Investor Relations & Finance, will participate in a roundtable presentation at BofA Securities Global Real Estate Conference on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 12:45 p.m. to 1:20 p.m. Eastern Time. A live webcast of the presentation will be available at the following
. A replay will be available at the same link following the completion of the conference on September 16, 2026 for up to one year.
The Company will issue its investor presentation on Monday, September 14, 2026, before market open, which can be found at:

American Healthcare REIT, Inc. (NYSE: AHR) is a real estate investment trust that acquires, owns and operates a diversified portfolio of clinical healthcare real estate, focusing primarily on senior housing communities, skilled nursing facilities, and outpatient medical buildings across the United States, the United Kingdom and the Isle of Man.
